# Step 62: 9½" wire from right strip lug 1 (S) to eyelet #13 (S)

> *Connect one end of a 9 ½" wire to lug #1 of the right screw terminal strip (S). Connect the other end to eyelet #13 (S). See pictorial.* — manual page 10

## What you're doing physically

A 9½" wire from lug 1 (YELLOW, 16 Ω tap) of the right 4-screw terminal strip to PC-3 eyelet #13. Both ends soldered.

Lug 1 of the right strip is now soldered final.

## What this is

Mirror of [step 60](step-60-left-strip-1-to-eyelet-12.md). Channel A secondary-tap feedback path. Audio at the 16 Ω output of the right speaker terminal is fed back to eyelet #13 on the PC-3 board, where it joins the input-stage feedback network.

The wire length (9½") is slightly shorter than step 60's 12" because the right channel's geometry on the chassis is mirror-symmetric to the left but happens to have shorter cable runs. Don't substitute a longer or shorter wire — the manual's lengths are calibrated for clean routing.
